name: CopilotCodeReviewDev
description: [Development Build] Perform automated code reviews on pull requests using the official GitHub Copilot CLI
author: LittleFortSoftware

inputs.name: useClaudeCode
inputs.label: Use Claude Code CLI
inputs.helpMarkDown: When enabled, uses Claude Code CLI (Anthropic) instead of GitHub Copilot CLI for the code review. Requires an Anthropic API key.

inputs.name: useCustomModelProvider
inputs.label: Use Custom Model Provider (BYOK)
inputs.helpMarkDown: When enabled, the GitHub Copilot CLI uses a custom model provider (bring your own key) instead of GitHub-hosted models. Requires a provider base URL, provider type, and an explicit 'model'. A GitHub PAT becomes optional in this mode. Cannot be combined with 'Use Claude Code CLI'. [Learn more](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/copilot-cli/customize-copilot/use-byok-models)

inputs.name: githubPat
inputs.label: GitHub PAT
inputs.helpMarkDown: Personal Access Token for GitHub with Copilot access. Required when using the GitHub Copilot CLI with GitHub-hosted models (default). Optional when 'Use Custom Model Provider' is enabled—providing it additionally enables GitHub-backed features such as code search. Not needed when 'Use Claude Code CLI' is enabled.

inputs.name: githubHost
inputs.label: GitHub Enterprise Host
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. GitHub Enterprise hostname (e.g., 'subdomain.ghe.com') for accounts with data residency. Sets the GH_HOST environment variable so the Copilot CLI validates the GitHub PAT against your enterprise instance instead of github.com. Leave empty for github.com accounts.

inputs.name: copilotProviderBaseUrl
inputs.label: Model Provider Base URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: Base URL of the custom model provider's API endpoint (e.g., 'https://api.openai.com/v1' or a local Ollama endpoint). Required when 'Use Custom Model Provider' is enabled.

inputs.name: copilotProviderType
inputs.label: Model Provider Type
inputs.helpMarkDown: Type of the custom model provider. Documented values: 'openai' (any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including Ollama and vLLM), 'azure', or 'anthropic'. Required when 'Use Custom Model Provider' is enabled.

inputs.name: copilotProviderApiKey
inputs.label: Model Provider API Key
inputs.helpMarkDown: API key for authenticating with the custom model provider. Optional—omit for providers that do not require authentication, such as a local Ollama instance.

inputs.name: anthropicApiKey
inputs.label: Anthropic API Key
inputs.helpMarkDown: API key for Anthropic's Claude Code CLI, billed against Anthropic API usage. When 'Use Claude Code CLI' is enabled, provide either this or a Claude Code OAuth Token — not both.

inputs.name: claudeCodeOAuthToken
inputs.label: Claude Code OAuth Token
inputs.helpMarkDown: Long-lived OAuth token generated by running 'claude setup-token' locally, billed against a Claude subscription (Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise) instead of API usage. When 'Use Claude Code CLI' is enabled, provide either this or an Anthropic API Key — not both.

inputs.name: maxTurns
inputs.label: Max Turns (Claude Code)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. Maximum number of agentic turns for Claude Code CLI. Limits how many tool-use iterations the agent can perform.

inputs.name: maxBudget
inputs.label: Max Budget USD (Claude Code)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. Maximum cost in USD for the Claude Code CLI session. The session will stop if this budget is reached.

inputs.name: azureDevOpsPat
inputs.label: Azure DevOps PAT
inputs.helpMarkDown: Personal Access Token for Azure DevOps. Used for retrieving pull request details and posting review comments. **Required for Azure DevOps Server (on-prem)**. For Azure DevOps Services (cloud), you can use the System Access Token instead by enabling the option below.

inputs.name: useSystemAccessToken
inputs.label: Use System Access Token
inputs.helpMarkDown: When enabled, uses the pipeline's System.AccessToken (OAuth) instead of a PAT. This is the Microsoft-recommended authentication method for Azure DevOps Services. **Note**: The Build Service identity must have 'Contribute to pull requests' permission on the repository. Not supported for Azure DevOps Server (on-prem).

inputs.name: organization
inputs.label: Organization
inputs.helpMarkDown: The Azure DevOps organization name for cloud-hosted instances (e.g., 'myorg' from https://dev.azure.com/myorg). For Azure DevOps Server (on-prem), use 'collectionUri' instead. If neither is specified, auto-detected from the pipeline context.

inputs.name: collectionUri
inputs.label: Collection URI
inputs.helpMarkDown: The full Azure DevOps collection URI (e.g., 'https://dev.azure.com/myorg', 'https://tfs.contoso.com/tfs/DefaultCollection'). If not specified, will be automatically detected from System.CollectionUri. Use this for Azure DevOps Server (on-prem) installations.

inputs.name: project
inputs.label: Project
inputs.helpMarkDown: The Azure DevOps project name. Defaults to $(System.TeamProject).

inputs.name: repository
inputs.label: Repository
inputs.helpMarkDown: The repository name where the pull request exists. Defaults to $(Build.Repository.Name).

inputs.name: pullRequestId
inputs.label: Pull Request ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: The ID of the pull request to review. If not specified, defaults to $(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId) when run as part of a PR validation build.

inputs.name: timeout
inputs.label: Timeout (minutes)
inputs.helpMarkDown: The maximum number of minutes to allow the Copilot review to run before timing out. Default is 15 minutes.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Copilot Model
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. The model to use for the review (e.g., 'claude-sonnet-5', 'gpt-5.5'). If not specified, uses the CLI's default model. **Required** when 'Use Custom Model Provider' is enabled—set it to a model identifier your provider serves.

inputs.name: reasoningEffort
inputs.label: Reasoning Effort
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. Reasoning effort level to control review depth and token spend. GitHub Copilot CLI accepts: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Claude Code CLI accepts: low, medium, high, xhigh, max. If the selected model does not support the requested level, the CLI fails with a clear error rather than ignoring it. Leave empty to use the model's default.

inputs.name: promptFile
inputs.label: Custom Prompt File
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. Path to a .txt file containing a custom prompt for Copilot. The file must exist and contain content.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.label: Custom Prompt
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. A custom prompt to pass directly to Copilot. If both prompt and promptFile are specified, prompt takes precedence.

inputs.name: promptRaw
inputs.label: Raw Prompt
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. A raw prompt to pass directly to the Copilot CLI with no modification. Cannot be combined with other prompt inputs (prompt, promptFile, promptFileRaw).

inputs.name: promptFileRaw
inputs.label: Raw Prompt File
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. Path to a file containing a raw prompt to pass directly to the Copilot CLI with no modification. Cannot be combined with other prompt inputs (prompt, promptFile, promptRaw).

inputs.name: authors
inputs.label: Author Filter
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. A comma-separated list of email addresses. If specified, the task will only run code reviews for PRs authored by users with matching email addresses. Uses $(Build.RequestedForEmail) for comparison.

inputs.name: includeWorkItems
inputs.label: Include Work Item Details
inputs.helpMarkDown: When enabled, fetches full details (title, description, acceptance criteria, repro steps) for work items linked to the pull request and includes them as context for the Copilot review. Disable to reduce API calls and context window usage.

inputs.name: jiraBaseUrl
inputs.label: Jira Base URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. Base URL of your Jira Cloud site (e.g., 'https://yourorg.atlassian.net'). When set together with 'Jira User Email' and 'Jira API Token', linked work items are fetched from Jira instead of Azure Boards. Issue keys (e.g., PROJ-123) are discovered from the PR's source branch name, title, and description. Jira Cloud only.

inputs.name: jiraEmail
inputs.label: Jira User Email
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. The Atlassian account email associated with the Jira API token. Required when 'Jira Base URL' is set.

inputs.name: jiraApiToken
inputs.label: Jira API Token
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. Jira Cloud API token created at https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens. Required when 'Jira Base URL' is set. Both classic and scoped API tokens are supported: scoped tokens (including service-account tokens, which can only be scoped) must include the 'read:jira-work' and 'read:jira-user' scopes and are routed through the Atlassian platform gateway automatically.

inputs.name: jiraProjectKeys
inputs.label: Jira Project Keys
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. Comma-separated list of Jira project keys (e.g., 'PROJ,CORE') to restrict which issue keys are looked up. Leave empty to try every key-shaped reference found in the PR (unknown keys are skipped automatically).

inputs.name: jiraCustomFields
inputs.label: Jira Custom Fields
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. Comma-separated list of Jira custom fields to include as review context, given as display names (case-insensitive, e.g. 'Acceptance Criteria') or field IDs (e.g. 'customfield_10031'). Names that don't exist on the site are skipped with a warning. A field name containing a comma cannot be expressed here — use its customfield ID instead.

inputs.name: resolveThreads
inputs.label: Thread Resolution Scope
inputs.helpMarkDown: Controls which existing comment threads the review agent may resolve when their issues have been addressed. 'all' (default): threads created by previous automated reviews, plus threads created by human reviewers when the changes clearly address them. 'agentOnly': only threads created by previous automated reviews — human reviewers' threads are never touched. Not applied to raw prompt modes (promptRaw/promptFileRaw).

inputs.name: suppressPositiveFeedback
inputs.label: Suppress Positive Feedback
inputs.helpMarkDown: When enabled, the review agent will not post praise or 'looks good' comments. If a review finds no impactful issues, no comment is posted at all. Not applied to raw prompt modes (promptRaw/promptFileRaw).

inputs.name: maxMinorIssues
inputs.label: Max Minor Issues Per Review
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maximum number of Minor-severity findings included in the consolidated minor-suggestions comment each review pass. Set to 0 to suppress Minor findings entirely. Critical and Major findings are never capped. Not applied to raw prompt modes (promptRaw/promptFileRaw).

inputs.name: diffOnlyReview
inputs.label: Diff-Only Review
inputs.helpMarkDown: When enabled, the review is restricted to ONLY the PR diff. The diff is pre-computed and embedded in the prompt, and CLI tool access is limited to posting comments only. This dramatically reduces token usage for large repositories. Compatible with all prompt modes — when using raw prompts, the diff context is appended to the end of the prompt.

inputs.name: publishPromptArtifacts
inputs.label: Publish Prompt Artifacts
inputs.helpMarkDown: When enabled, publishes all context files (PR details, iteration details, work items, commit SHAs) and the final assembled prompt as pipeline artifacts. Useful for debugging prompt construction and reviewing what context the CLI agent received.
